purpose: A bounded working method for a residential solar seller who earns a commission or fee per installed system: how to choose and govern the licensed installer partners whose workmanship and install backlog the seller's name rides on, how to run the post-signature handoff and install-timeline communication that keeps a signed contract from decaying into a cancellation, how to administer cancellations and commission chargebacks as contract mechanisms rather than surprises, and how to convert only verified-happy, energized installs into the referral and review flow that is the single compounding asset a transaction-commission business owns.
assumptions: no observed dataset supplied; all scores are heuristic priors

the seller does not hold the contractor, electrical, or structural licence and does not perform, engineer, inspect, or warrant the installation; a licensed installer partner builds, energizes, and warrants the system while the seller owns representation, expectation-setting, and homeowner communication

income is transactional - a commission or fee per installed system, paid against contract milestones and reversible by chargeback - so there is no contracted recurring revenue in this vertical and the only compounding asset is the reputation held by past customers and the referred pipeline it produces

every cycle time, backlog depth, chargeback trigger, payment milestone, adder amount, referral yield, and cancellation rate named here is a quantity to be read from the partner agreement, the installer's own job records, the commission statement, or the seller's own install ledger; this knowledge base supplies the mechanism and the verification route, never the value

right-to-cancel windows, door-to-door and remote-sale consumer-protection duties, referral-compensation disclosure rules, and review-solicitation rules are obligation classes whose current form differs by jurisdiction, contract type, and platform policy and must be verified with the issuing authority or platform before being relied on
exclusions: choosing between the commissioned-representative, dealer, and referral market models, designing or comparing commission structures and where commission risk sits at the economics level, lead-generation channel selection and its cost-quality trade-offs, honest homeowner qualification at the front of the funnel, and sales-cycle stage and pipeline math - all of which belong to the sibling solar market-models and lead-economics knowledge base; this knowledge base begins at the signed contract and at the partner who will build it

site and usage qualification, consumption analysis against a utility rate schedule, roof orientation, tilt and shade modelling, production estimation, offset design, proposal integrity and rate-escalator honesty, financing-structure literacy across cash, loan, lease and power-purchase-agreement classes, and permitting and interconnection process literacy - all of which belong to the sibling site-qualification, proposal-integrity and financing-literacy knowledge base; here those topics appear only as live-job status to be communicated, never as the analysis itself

stating any specific commission rate, dealer fee, per-watt spread, adder price, cycle-time figure, cancellation percentage, referral yield, cooling-off window length, or backlog depth as fact; every such quantity is treated only as a mechanism - where the number comes from, what moves it, and which document, statement, or job record establishes it for a given partner or deal

contractor, electrical, and structural licensing, engineering and code compliance, structural and roofing work, equipment and workmanship warranty obligations, permit drawings, inspection remediation, and post-install service and monitoring diagnostics, all of which belong to the licensed installer or the operations-and-maintenance provider and are never performed, diagnosed, or promised by the selling side

personalized financial, tax, legal, or insurance advice to a homeowner or to the seller, including whether a given incentive applies to a household, whether to litigate a chargeback, and how to structure the seller's own entity or taxes; those belong with the homeowner's or seller's own qualified advisors

high-pressure retention conduct of any kind - delaying, obstructing, or 'losing' a cancellation request, manufactured urgency to prevent a cancellation, misrepresenting the consequences of cancelling, or implying a homeowner cannot cancel - which is excluded as prohibited conduct rather than discouraged practice

review gating, purchased or fabricated reviews, undisclosed incentives for reviews or referrals, and conditioning any remedy on the removal of a public complaint, all of which are excluded as prohibited conduct and as platform and consumer-protection violations to be verified in the operating jurisdiction

competency_questions.question: How do I choose which installer to sell for when my name is the one the homeowner will remember in five years, and how do I check build quality with evidence instead of the installer's recruiting deck?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: REPUTATION_AS_DURABLE_ASSET establishes why partner choice is a reputation decision rather than a pay decision, INSTALLER_PARTNER_CRITERIA_MODEL supplies the weighted criteria and the disqualifiers, and BUILD_QUALITY_EVIDENCE_GATHERING names the first-hand evidence routes - finished-install site visits, inspection and re-inspection history, punch-list closure records, and unscripted past-customer conversations

competency_questions.question: How deep is this installer's backlog really, and what timeline am I therefore allowed to state to a homeowner at the kitchen table?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: INSTALL_BACKLOG_AND_CYCLE_TIME_READ describes reading stage-by-stage cycle times from a completed job cohort rather than an average quoted by a recruiter, and ties the range the seller may state to the observed spread of that cohort with the gating stage named

competency_questions.question: What in the dealer or referral agreement actually decides when I get paid and under what conditions the money can be taken back?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: PARTNER_AGREEMENT_TERMS_LITERACY maps the payment-milestone clauses, the chargeback and offset triggers, lead-ownership, territory, termination, and post-termination treatment of in-flight deals, and states that the written terms govern over any verbal assurance

competency_questions.question: Should I sell for one installer or several, and what happens to my in-flight deals and my past customers if the installer fails, exits my market, or terminates me?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: INSTALLER_CONTINUITY_RISK_DILIGENCE names the observable distress and stability signals and PARTNER_CONCENTRATION_AND_EXIT_PLANNING gives the concentration decision plus a pre-written exit path covering in-flight deals, unpaid milestones, and warranty routing for past customers

competency_questions.question: At signature, what exactly moves to the installer, what record proves what the homeowner was told, and from that moment which questions are mine to answer and which are the installer's?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: HANDOFF_PACKET_AND_EXPECTATION_RECORD lists the packet contents and the dated expectation log, POST_SIGNATURE_ACCOUNTABILITY_STANCE fixes the seller as the homeowner's standing point of contact, and ROLE_BOUNDARY_WITH_LICENSED_INSTALLER draws the answer-versus-route line for technical, code, and warranty questions

competency_questions.question: What do I say to a homeowner during the silent weeks between site survey, engineering, permit, and install day, and how often do I say it?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: MILESTONE_COMMUNICATION_CADENCE defines milestone-keyed contact including the deliberate no-change check-in, who says what so the seller never contradicts the installer, and the logging of every commitment made

competency_questions.question: The job just slipped or the design came back changed - how do I deliver that news, and how fast?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: DELAY_AND_BAD_NEWS_PROTOCOL requires the seller to carry the news first, name the gating stage and its owner, give the next verifiable checkpoint rather than a hopeful date, and open a written escalation with the installer

competency_questions.question: The site survey came back with a main-panel upgrade or a roof condition that changes the price or the scope - what must be re-disclosed, re-consented, and re-signed before anything continues?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CHANGE_ORDER_AND_ADDER_REDISCLOSURE requires written re-disclosure of the changed price, scope, and payment consequence, an explicit fresh decision by the homeowner including the option to stop, and a restatement of any cancellation right whose current form is verified for the jurisdiction

competency_questions.question: The panels are on the roof but the utility has not granted permission to operate and the homeowner just received a full utility bill - what do I owe them right now?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: POST_INSTALL_ACTIVATION_AND_FIRST_BILL_WALKTHROUGH covers the pre-framed dark period between install and activation, monitoring setup after activation, the first-bill and true-up walkthrough against the homeowner's own statements, and punch-list closure before the job is called done

competency_questions.question: Why did these signed deals cancel, which causes were mine rather than the installer's, and how do I keep score of that per partner?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CANCELLATION_CAUSE_TAXONOMY classifies each cancellation to a cause and an owner at the moment it happens, PARTNER_SCORECARD_AND_REVIEW_CADENCE aggregates those causes per partner alongside cycle time and escalation behaviour, and REFERRAL_YIELD_AND_REPUTATION_LEDGER shows whether the surviving installs are producing referred pipeline

competency_questions.question: A homeowner tells me they want to cancel - what am I allowed to do, what must I do immediately, and where does a save attempt stop being legitimate?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: RIGHT_TO_CANCEL_AND_SAVE_ETHICS requires immediate written acknowledgement and routing through the contract's stated cancellation channel, permits at most one non-pressuring question about cause if the homeowner is willing, and prohibits delay, re-pitching after a clear decision, or any suggestion that cancelling is not available

competency_questions.question: My commission statement shows a deduction I did not expect - how do I reconcile it and dispute it without guessing?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CLAWBACK_ADMINISTRATION_AND_DISPUTE describes reconciling each deduction to a named contract trigger and a deal-level record, requesting the backup detail, disputing in writing inside the contractual window with the job evidence attached, and treating unexplained or recurring deductions as a partner-level signal

competency_questions.question: When is a customer actually ready to be asked for a referral or a review, and how do I ask without pressure, without hiding compensation, and without breaking platform rules?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: VERIFIED_HAPPY_INSTALL_GATE defines the objective eligibility conditions before any ask, REFERRAL_REQUEST_MECHANICS gives the single-ask, opt-out-respecting request with disclosure of any compensation, and REVIEW_AND_PUBLIC_REPUTATION_PRACTICE forbids gating, incentivised-without-disclosure, or fabricated reviews and flags platform and jurisdiction verification

competency_questions.question: A public complaint, a bad review, or a consumer-protection inquiry has landed on a deal I sold - what do I do first, and what am I not allowed to do?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: COMPLAINT_AND_ESCALATION_HANDLING requires acknowledgement, reconstruction of the job record and the dated expectation log, a remedy path routed to whoever owns the defect, honest attribution, and prohibits conditioning any remedy on withdrawal of the complaint or disclosing the customer's private details in public

glossary.definition: The utility's written authorization, granted after inspection and interconnection review, that allows a completed system to be switched on and to export; until it lands the homeowner has hardware on the roof and no production, which makes the gap between install day and PTO the most complaint-dense window in the job and a mandatory item in expectation-setting.

The queue of sold-but-unbuilt jobs an installer is carrying, expressed as the depth of work ahead of a newly submitted deal; it is read from the installer's own job records by stage rather than from a quoted average, and it is the quantity that turns a seller's stated timeline into either a kept promise or a cancellation.

A set of completed jobs from the same installer and roughly the same period whose stage dates - signature, survey, engineering, permit issue, install, inspection, activation - are read together so the seller sees the real spread and the slowest gating stage instead of a best-case anecdote.

The contractual reversal or offset of a commission already paid or accrued when a triggering event occurs, such as a cancellation before install, a funding failure, or a customer refund; the trigger list, the offset mechanics, and the dispute window are properties of the specific partner agreement and must be read from it rather than assumed.

The itemized list of unfinished or defective items identified at or after install - conduit routing, sealant, trim, debris, damaged tile, mislabelled disconnects - whose documented closure is one of the objective conditions separating a finished job from a job that merely has panels on it.

A cost item that appears after the original agreement because the site requires it - a main-panel upgrade, roof repair or reroof, structural reinforcement, trenching, or a de-rate remedy - and whose appearance changes price or scope and therefore triggers written re-disclosure and a fresh homeowner decision.

The homeowner's contractual and statutory ability to withdraw from the agreement, whose window, form, and delivery method are an obligation class that varies by jurisdiction, sale setting, and contract type; the seller's duty is to state it accurately, honour it immediately, and verify its current form with the issuing authority rather than reciting a remembered rule.

The pre-agreed sequence of named contacts and response expectations inside the installer organization - coordinator, project manager, operations lead - that a seller uses in writing when a job stalls or a defect appears, established before the first job rather than improvised during the first crisis.

A job that has objectively cleared the conditions that make advocacy honest: energized with activation granted, production visible in monitoring, punch list closed, first post-activation bill walked through, and no open complaint - the gate that must pass before any referral or review request is made.

The measured rate at which a cohort of completed installs produces introductions, appointments, and eventually installed deals over the following periods; it is computed from the seller's own install ledger and source-tagged pipeline, and it is the lagging indicator that tells a transaction-commission business whether its reputation is compounding or decaying.
